prompt: Create a full-body fashion portrait of a stylish young woman in a soft watercolor illustration style, with delicate brush textures, subtle ink bleeding, gentle paper grain, and a clean warm cream watercolor paper background. The subject stands facing the camera in a relaxed urban street-fashion pose, weight shifted casually, one hand tucked into a pants pocket and the other arm hanging down while holding the strap of a shoulder bag. She has long dark hair in two loose braids, a black ribbed beanie, small hoop earrings, layered delicate necklaces, and narrow dark sunglasses. Dress her in an off-shoulder cropped gray sweatshirt with visible printed text reading LOS ANGELES / CALIFORNIA / EST. 1984, oversized black drawstring wide-leg track pants, chunky white sneakers, and a shiny metallic silver shoulder bag. Keep the proportions elegant and fashion-editorial, with soft facial features, muted shadows, translucent watercolor washes, light graphite-like outlines, and subtle pooling of pigment around the feet. Use a minimal composition with no scenery, no extra people, no border, no watermark, and no additional text beyond the sweatshirt print.

promptZh: 创作一张全身时尚人像，主体为 一位时尚的年轻女性，采用柔和的水彩插画风格，呈现细腻的笔触纹理、微妙的墨水晕染、柔和的纸张质感，以及干净的暖米色水彩纸背景。主体面向镜头，呈现放松的都市街头时尚姿态，重心随意偏移，一只手插在裤兜里，另一只手臂自然下垂并握住单肩包的肩带。她留着深色长发，梳成两条松散的辫子，戴着黑色罗纹针织帽、小圆圈耳环、叠戴的精致项链以及窄框深色墨镜。为她穿上一件露肩灰色短款卫衣，上面印有 LOS ANGELES / CALIFORNIA / EST. 1984 字样，搭配超大款黑色抽绳阔腿运动裤、厚底白色运动鞋以及闪亮的金属银色单肩包。保持优雅的时尚杂志比例，面部特征柔和，阴影柔和，水彩晕染通透，带有淡淡的石墨线条感，脚部周围有微妙的颜料堆积效果。采用极简构图，背景无其他景物，无额外人物，无边框，无水印，除卫衣印花外不包含任何额外文字。
